text:
Situation: Succinylchloride chloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation on 2026-07-23. Corvale East holds 75 vials (20.5 days); Corvale General holds 106 vials (26.1 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows succinylcholine chloride is not listed as of 2026-10-21. A registered plant for Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited (FEI 3008461619) was classified OAI after an inspection ending 2026-02-06. The same plant received a Warning Letter on 2024-08-15 following an earlier OAI inspection ending 2024-02-02.

Our position: Current inventory covers roughly three to four weeks. No FDA shortage listing exists. The Fresenius discontinuation reduces one supply source. The Eugia plant regulatory history warrants monitoring but does not confirm a current supply interruption for our contracted products.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. can supply the 20 mg/mL 10 mL multidose vial presentation and confirms its manufacturing site regulatory status; P&T Committee approves addition to formulary if verified.
2. Buyer verifies Baxter Healthcare Corporation supply capability and site status; P&T Committee approves addition if verified.
3. Buyer verifies Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. supply capability and site status; P&T Committee approves addition if verified.
4. Buyer verifies Civica, Inc. supply capability and site status; P&T Committee approves addition if verified.
5. Buyer verifies Devatis, Inc. supply capability and site status; P&T Committee approves addition if verified.

Not recommended: Initiate clinical conservation protocols or alternative agent protocols at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee if supply deteriorates.
